## Can I use a cloud LLM instead of Ollama?

Yes - add any OpenAI-compatible endpoint under `providers` in `../.berg-agents`:

```jsonc
"providers": {
  "openai": {
    "options": { "baseURL": "https://api.openai.com/v1", "apiKey": "${env:OPENAI_API_KEY}" },
    "models": { "gpt-4o": {} }
  }
}
```

The provider is derived **from the model id** - there is no global provider flag.
Switch at runtime via the web model selector.
See [Configuration](CONFIGURATION.qmd).

## How do I configure MCP servers?

Point `BERG_AGENT_MCP_SERVERS` at a JSON file (default `../.berg-agents/mcp.json`) and reference secrets with `${env:VAR}`.
See [Configuration](CONFIGURATION.qmd).

## What Python version do I need?

Python 3.12+.
Dependencies via `uv` (`uv pip install -e .`).
